```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .fp-wrap{ max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem; }

  /* Search bar row */
  .fp-search{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto 130px;
    gap:.6rem;
    padding:1.1rem 1.25rem;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    margin-bottom:1.25rem;
    align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width: 780px){
    .fp-search{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }
  .fp-search input[type=search]{
    padding:.65rem .85rem;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    font-size:.95rem;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    background:#fff;
  }
  .fp-search input:focus{ outline:none; border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,148,136,.1); }
  .fp-search button{
    padding:.65rem 1rem;
    border-radius:4px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:.9rem;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .15s;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .fp-search button.primary{
    background:var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    color:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-red,#0d9488);
  }
  .fp-search button.primary:hover{ background:#0f766e; }
  .fp-search button.ghost{
    background:#fff;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
  }
  .fp-search button.ghost:hover{ border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); }
  .fp-search select{
    padding:.65rem .85rem;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    font-size:.9rem;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;
    background:#fff;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    cursor:pointer;
  }

  /* Main split — map left, results right */
  .fp-split{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;
    gap:1.25rem;
    align-items:stretch;
  }
  @media (max-width: 960px){ .fp-split{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  #fp-map{
    height:640px;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    z-index:1;
  }
  @media (max-width: 960px){ #fp-map{ height:400px; } }

  /* Results list */
  .fp-results{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    max-height:640px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .fp-results-head{
    padding:.9rem 1.1rem;
    background:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:1rem;
  }
  .fp-results-head h4{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:1rem;
  }
  .fp-results-head .meta{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
    font-size:.75rem;
    opacity:.75;
  }
  .fp-results-body{ overflow-y:auto; padding:.5rem; }

  .fp-empty{
    padding:2rem 1.25rem;
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    font-size:.9rem;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  .fp-empty svg{ opacity:.35; margin-bottom:.5rem; }

  .fp-card{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:36px 1fr auto;
    gap:.75rem;
    padding:.85rem .9rem;
    border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;
    align-items:start;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .12s;
  }
  .fp-card:last-child{ border-bottom:0; }
  .fp-card:hover{ background:#f8fafc; }
  .fp-card.active{ background:#f0fdfa; }

  .fp-num{
    width:32px;
    height:32px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:.85rem;
  }

  .fp-name{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:.98rem;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    line-height:1.25;
    margin:0 0 .15rem;
  }
  .fp-meta{
    font-size:.78rem;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    line-height:1.35;
    margin:0 0 .35rem;
  }
  .fp-meta .type{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    font-size:.7rem;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.04em;
    margin-right:.35rem;
  }
  .fp-actions{
    display:flex;
    gap:.4rem;
    margin-top:.2rem;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .fp-actions a{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:.25rem;
    padding:.28rem .55rem;
    font-size:.75rem;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;
    font-weight:500;
    border-radius:3px;
    text-decoration:none;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    background:#fff;
    transition:all .12s;
  }
  .fp-actions a:hover{ border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); }
  .fp-actions a.directions{ background:var(--map-red,#0d9488); color:#fff; border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); }
  .fp-actions a.directions:hover{ background:#0f766e; color:#fff; }

  .fp-dist{
    text-align:right;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    font-size:.95rem;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .fp-dist .sub{
    display:block;
    font-size:.65rem;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    letter-spacing:.05em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:400;
    margin-top:.15rem;
  }

  .fp-status{
    padding:.7rem 1rem;
    font-size:.85rem;
    background:rgba(13,148,136,.05);
    border-left:3px solid var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;
    margin-bottom:1rem;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
  }
  .fp-status.error{ background:#fef2f2; border-left-color:#dc2626; color:#991b1b; }
</style>

<section class="page-banner">
  <div style="max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Find the nearest pharmacy</h1>
    <p>Enter your address, share your location, or drop a pin on the map &mdash; PharmaScope returns the closest accredited CPPs with contact details and one-tap directions.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="fp-wrap">

  <div class="fp-status" id="fp-status">Loading pharmacy registry&hellip;</div>

  <div class="fp-search">
    <input type="search" id="fp-addr" placeholder="Ward, town or landmark — e.g. Ifakara, Kariakoo, Ubungo" autocomplete="off"/>
    <button class="ghost" id="fp-locate" title="Use my current location">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:.3rem;"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="22"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="4" y2="12"/><line x1="20" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg>
      My location
    </button>
    <select id="fp-type" title="Filter by business type">
      <option value="">All types</option>
      <option value="Retail A">Retail A</option>
      <option value="Retail Wholesale">Retail Wholesale</option>
    </select>
    <select id="fp-count" title="Number of results">
      <option value="5">Top 5</option>
      <option value="10" selected>Top 10</option>
      <option value="20">Top 20</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="fp-split">

    <div id="fp-map"></div>

    <div class="fp-results">
      <div class="fp-results-head">
        <h4 id="fp-results-title">Nearest pharmacies</h4>
        <span class="meta" id="fp-results-meta">&mdash;</span>
      </div>
      <div class="fp-results-body" id="fp-results-body">
        <div class="fp-empty" id="fp-empty">
          <svg width="42" height="42" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>
          <div>Search an address, use your location, or click anywhere on the map to see the nearest pharmacies.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const CSV_URL = "data/tanzania/addo_standardized.csv";

  // ── Map + basemaps ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Users need to identify streets, wards, and landmarks when finding a
  // pharmacy, so we default to a labeled OSM/Voyager basemap rather than
  // a stripped-down light layer.
  const map = L.map("fp-map", { preferCanvas: true }).setView([-6.4, 35.0], 6);

  const baseVoyager = L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager_labels_under/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    { attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap &copy; CARTO", maxZoom: 19 });
  const baseOSM = L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
    { attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors", maxZoom: 19 });
  const baseSat = L.tileLayer(
    "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    { attribution: "&copy; Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics", maxZoom: 19 });

  baseVoyager.addTo(map);
  L.control.layers({ "Voyager (labels)": baseVoyager, "OpenStreetMap": baseOSM, "Satellite": baseSat },
    null, { position: "topleft", collapsed: true }).addTo(map);

  const backdropLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);   // faint markers of all outlets — nation-wide overview
  const resultsLayer  = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);   // numbered result markers
  let userMarker = null;
  let hasLocation = false;                            // controls backdrop visibility

  // Hide the faint backdrop of all outlets once the user picks a location:
  // the numbered result pins are what matters at that point, and the extra
  // dots at high zoom obscure the labeled street map.
  function updateBackdropVisibility() {
    const shouldShow = !hasLocation && map.getZoom() < 10;
    if (shouldShow && !map.hasLayer(backdropLayer)) map.addLayer(backdropLayer);
    else if (!shouldShow && map.hasLayer(backdropLayer)) map.removeLayer(backdropLayer);
  }
  map.on("zoomend", updateBackdropVisibility);

  // ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let all = [];
  let currentLoc = null;

  const els = {
    status:    document.getElementById("fp-status"),
    addr:      document.getElementById("fp-addr"),
    locate:    document.getElementById("fp-locate"),
    typeFilt:  document.getElementById("fp-type"),
    countSel:  document.getElementById("fp-count"),
    resultsBody: document.getElementById("fp-results-body"),
    resultsMeta: document.getElementById("fp-results-meta"),
    empty:     document.getElementById("fp-empty"),
  };

  // ── Load CPP data ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  Papa.parse(CSV_URL, {
    download: true, header: true, skipEmptyLines: true, dynamicTyping: false,
    complete: (res) => {
      all = res.data
        .filter(r => r.has_coords === "True" || r.has_coords === "true")
        .map(r => ({
          name: r.addo_name,
          business_type: r.business_type,
          accreditation_source: r.accreditation_source,
          region: r.region,
          district: r.district,
          ward: r.ward,
          village_street: r.village_street,
          phone: r.phone,
          lat: parseFloat(r.latitude),
          lon: parseFloat(r.longitude),
        }))
        .filter(r => Number.isFinite(r.lat) && Number.isFinite(r.lon));
      for (const r of all) {
        L.circleMarker([r.lat, r.lon], {
          radius: 1.5, color: "#94a3b8", weight: 0, fillColor: "#94a3b8", fillOpacity: 0.35,
          interactive: false,
        }).addTo(backdropLayer);
      }
      els.status.innerHTML = `<strong>${all.length.toLocaleString()}</strong> accredited outlets loaded. Search an address, use your location, or click the map.`;
    },
    error: (err) => {
      els.status.className = "fp-status error";
      els.status.textContent = "Failed to load pharmacy registry: " + err.message;
    },
  });

  // ── Wire interactions ────────────────────────────────────────────
  map.on("click", (e) => setLocation(e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng, "Dropped pin"));

  els.addr.addEventListener("keydown", async (e) => {
    if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
    const q = els.addr.value.trim();
    if (!q) return;
    els.addr.disabled = true;
    try {
      const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&countrycodes=tz&limit=1&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`;
      const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { "Accept-Language": "en" } });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.length) setLocation(parseFloat(data[0].lat), parseFloat(data[0].lon), data[0].display_name);
      else alert("Address not found in Tanzania. Try a nearby town or drop a pin on the map.");
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Geocoding failed: " + err.message);
    } finally { els.addr.disabled = false; }
  });

  els.locate.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) { alert("Geolocation is not supported by this browser."); return; }
    els.locate.disabled = true;
    els.locate.textContent = "Locating…";
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        els.locate.disabled = false;
        els.locate.innerHTML = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:.3rem;"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="22"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="4" y2="12"/><line x1="20" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg> My location`;
        setLocation(pos.coords.latitude, pos.coords.longitude, "My location");
      },
      (err) => {
        els.locate.disabled = false;
        els.locate.innerHTML = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:.3rem;"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="22"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="4" y2="12"/><line x1="20" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg> My location`;
        alert("Could not get your location: " + err.message);
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 },
    );
  });

  els.typeFilt.addEventListener("change", () => currentLoc && recompute());
  els.countSel.addEventListener("change", () => currentLoc && recompute());

  // ── Core: set user location + recompute nearest ──────────────────
  function setLocation(lat, lon, label) {
    currentLoc = { lat, lon, label };
    hasLocation = true;
    updateBackdropVisibility();

    if (userMarker) map.removeLayer(userMarker);
    userMarker = L.marker([lat, lon], {
      icon: L.divIcon({
        className: "fp-user",
        html: `<div style="width:26px;height:26px;background:#0f172a;border:4px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.15);"></div>`,
        iconSize: [26, 26], iconAnchor: [13, 13],
      }),
      title: label || "Your location",
    }).addTo(map);

    recompute();
  }

  function recompute() {
    if (!currentLoc) return;
    const { lat, lon } = currentLoc;
    const typeFilter = els.typeFilt.value;
    const N = parseInt(els.countSel.value, 10);

    // Filter, distance, sort, take top N
    const withDist = all
      .filter(r => !typeFilter || r.business_type === typeFilter)
      .map(r => ({ ...r, dist_km: haversineKm(lat, lon, r.lat, r.lon) }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.dist_km - b.dist_km)
      .slice(0, N);

    // Draw numbered markers
    resultsLayer.clearLayers();
    withDist.forEach((r, i) => {
      const n = i + 1;
      const marker = L.marker([r.lat, r.lon], {
        icon: L.divIcon({
          className: "fp-result-pin",
          html: `<div style="width:34px;height:34px;background:#0d9488;color:#fff;border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.15);">${n}</div>`,
          iconSize: [34, 34], iconAnchor: [17, 17],
        }),
      }).bindPopup(popupHtml(r, n)).addTo(resultsLayer);
      marker.on("click", () => highlightResult(n));
    });

    // Fit map to user + all results
    if (withDist.length) {
      const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[lat, lon], ...withDist.map(r => [r.lat, r.lon])]);
      map.fitBounds(bounds.pad(0.2), { maxZoom: 14 });
    } else {
      map.setView([lat, lon], 12);
    }

    renderList(withDist);
  }

  function highlightResult(n) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".fp-card").forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle("active", parseInt(el.dataset.n, 10) === n);
      if (parseInt(el.dataset.n, 10) === n) el.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
    });
  }

  function haversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    const R = 6371;
    const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
    const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
    const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
              Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
              Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
    return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  }

  function renderList(rows) {
    if (!rows.length) {
      els.resultsBody.innerHTML = `<div class="fp-empty">No accredited outlets match this filter within Tanzania. Try changing the business-type filter.</div>`;
      els.resultsMeta.textContent = "0 results";
      return;
    }
    els.resultsMeta.textContent = `${rows.length} nearest`;
    els.resultsBody.innerHTML = rows.map((r, i) => {
      const n = i + 1;
      const loc = [r.ward, r.district, r.region].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
      const gmapsUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${r.lat},${r.lon}&travelmode=driving`;
      const phone = cleanPhone(r.phone);
      return `
        <div class="fp-card" data-n="${n}" data-lat="${r.lat}" data-lon="${r.lon}">
          <div class="fp-num">${n}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="fp-name">${escapeHtml(r.name || "—")}</div>
            <div class="fp-meta"><span class="type">${escapeHtml(r.business_type || "")}</span>${escapeHtml(loc || "—")}</div>
            <div class="fp-actions">
              <a href="${gmapsUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="directions">
                <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polygon points="3 11 22 2 13 21 11 13 3 11"/></svg>
                Directions
              </a>
              ${phone ? `<a href="tel:${phone}"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 .7 2.81 2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/></svg>${escapeHtml(phone)}</a>` : ""}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="fp-dist">
            ${r.dist_km.toFixed(2)}<span class="sub">km</span>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join("");

    // Clicking a card zooms/highlights its marker
    document.querySelectorAll(".fp-card").forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        // Don't hijack link clicks
        if (e.target.closest("a")) return;
        const n = parseInt(el.dataset.n, 10);
        const lat = parseFloat(el.dataset.lat);
        const lon = parseFloat(el.dataset.lon);
        highlightResult(n);
        map.setView([lat, lon], 15);
        resultsLayer.getLayers().forEach((layer, i) => {
          if (i + 1 === n) layer.openPopup();
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function popupHtml(r, n) {
    const loc = [r.ward, r.district, r.region].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
    const gmapsUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${r.lat},${r.lon}&travelmode=driving`;
    const phone = cleanPhone(r.phone);
    return `
      <div style="min-width:200px;">
        <strong style="font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;">${n}. ${escapeHtml(r.name || "—")}</strong><br/>
        <span style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:#64748b;">${escapeHtml(r.business_type || "")}</span><br/>
        <span style="font-size:.85rem;">${escapeHtml(loc || "—")}</span><br/>
        <div style="margin-top:.4rem;color:#0d9488;font-weight:600;">${r.dist_km.toFixed(2)} km away</div>
        <div style="margin-top:.4rem;display:flex;gap:.35rem;">
          <a href="${gmapsUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="background:#0d9488;color:#fff;padding:.25rem .55rem;border-radius:3px;text-decoration:none;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;">Directions</a>
          ${phone ? `<a href="tel:${phone}" style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;color:#0f172a;padding:.25rem .55rem;border-radius:3px;text-decoration:none;font-size:.75rem;">${escapeHtml(phone)}</a>` : ""}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function cleanPhone(p) {
    if (!p) return null;
    const s = String(p).trim();
    // Strip anything non-digit / non-plus, then rebuild
    const digits = s.replace(/[^\d+]/g, "");
    return digits || null;
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]));
  }
})();
</script>
```
